summary: Dependency-free SVG bar chart: vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, with per-series textures, keyboard navigation and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Comparing quantities across categories (regions, products, quarters).
Stacked, to show composition and total per category.
Horizontal, when category labels are long or numerous.
whenNotToUse: Continuous trends over time with many points: use LineChart.
Shares of a single total: use DonutChart.
A single value against a maximum: use Meter or Progress.

props.name: categories
props.description: Categories (one group of bars each), in order.

props.name: series
props.description: Series; data[i] maps to categories[i]. null draws no bar.

props.name: layout
props.description: Side-by-side or stacked series (positive and negative values stacked separately).

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px; width follows the container.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of values and ticks in the current locale.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend; with multiple series each entry is a button that shows/hides the series.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called when the legend changes the visible series.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradients, rounded shapes and glows with the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area, then to the legend and the table button.
Next category: highlights the band and announces the values.

accessibility: <figure> with <figcaption>; focusable role="group" chart area with a hint (aria-describedby) and aria-live="polite" announcements.
Series are distinguishable without color: every series after the first has a texture (hatching, dots, stripes) repeated in the legend.
Complete data table (caption, column and row headers) opened by a button with aria-expanded.
In forced-colors mode bars become Canvas with a CanvasText border and texture; the active category has a Highlight outline.
responsive: Width measured with ResizeObserver (560 px SSR fallback); labels are thinned out when space is short.
In horizontal orientation long labels are truncated with "…" (at most 40% of the width); the full text is in the table.
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default; it reverts to flat in forced-colors mode.
commonMistakes: Stacking series with different units: the total is meaningless.
Using vertical orientation with long labels: prefer orientation="horizontal".
Using 0 instead of null for missing data.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradients and glows with the theme colors.

limits: A single linear value axis; no value labels above the bars.
Label width is estimated, not measured: very wide fonts may overlap.
No zoom or virtualization; the SVG is still drawn left to right in RTL.
